description: A fixed-form AREA-A ITEM - a division, section or paragraph header, a level indicator (FD, SD, RD), level-number 01 or 77, DECLARATIVES, END DECLARATIVES or an end marker - that does not start in area A (character positions 8-11; a line-alone item, DECLARATIVES or END DECLARATIVES, §1985:IV.7.5, must also begin its line). THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): §1985:IV.7.2 'Area A occupies character positions 8, 9, 10, and 11, and is between margin A and margin B.'; the division header and the section header 'must start in area A' (§1985:IV.7.3.1, §1985:IV.7.3.2), 'The paragraph header or paragraph-name starts in area A of any line following the first line of a division or a section.' (§1985:IV.7.3.3), a level indicator and a level-number 01 or 77 'begins in area A, followed by at least one space' (§1985:IV.7.4), DECLARATIVES and END DECLARATIVES 'Each must begin in area A' (§1985:IV.7.5) and 'The end program header must start in area A.' (§1985:IV.7.6). ISO/IEC 1989:2002 removed the split: §2002:6.2 'The program-text area begins in character position 8 and terminates with the character position immediately to the left of margin R.', and §2002:F.2 item 54 'Areas A and B of the previous COBOL standard reference format have been combined into one area called the program-text area. Restrictions of area A and area B have been removed.'; §2014:6.3 and §2023:6.3.1 print the same program-text area (VCR row 7.35). So the placement is free from 2002 on and an area-A item outside area A is refused at COBOL-85 (kb/Work PB3147). Asked of every token by ONE pass, AreaPlacementPass, from the reference format's own record of where each fixed-form line's text begins (ReferenceFormatMap.PlacementAt through FixedFormAreas). Corroborating, not authority: GnuCOBOL 3.2's cobol85.conf sets areacheck: yes and its cobol2002.conf areacheck: no, and the NIST CCVS-85 corpus writes every area-A item in area A (NC113M tests positions 8-11, OBNC1M's comment-entry is a whole program in area B).
display: an area-A item that does not start in area A of its fixed-form line (DECLARATIVES and END DECLARATIVES must also begin their line)
vcr: VCR Table 7 row 7.35 - areas A and B of the fixed-form program-text area, removed in 2002
